create_P2Percentile: create a streaming P-square percentile estimator that tracks p90 or p99 latency with O(1) memory
create_StatsCounter: create a stats counter that tracks average time, p90, and p99 percentiles for pipeline stage timing
use_time_str: use the time_str function to format a float duration into a human-readable string with us, ms, or sec units
use_is_eof: use the is_eof function to check whether a pipeline item is the EOF sentinel value
use_periodic_dispatch: use the periodic_dispatch async function to repeatedly call a coroutine at a fixed interval until a done event is set
